# localization { #keecas.localization }

`localization`

Simplified localization module for keecas.

Provides simple translation dictionary lookup with config hierarchy support.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_language_from_config](#keecas.localization.get_language_from_config) | Get language setting from main config system. |
| [get_custom_replacements_from_config](#keecas.localization.get_custom_replacements_from_config) | Get custom replacements from main config system. |
| [get_translations](#keecas.localization.get_translations) | Get complete translation dictionary for a language. |
| [translate](#keecas.localization.translate) | Translate a single key. |
| [set_language](#keecas.localization.set_language) | Set the global language. |
| [get_language](#keecas.localization.get_language) | Get current global language. |
| [get_available_languages](#keecas.localization.get_available_languages) | Get list of available language codes. |
| [set_runtime_override](#keecas.localization.set_runtime_override) | Set a runtime translation override. |
| [clear_runtime_overrides](#keecas.localization.clear_runtime_overrides) | Clear all runtime overrides. |
| [reset_to_config](#keecas.localization.reset_to_config) | Reset to config defaults, clearing runtime overrides. |

### get_language_from_config { #keecas.localization.get_language_from_config }

```python
get_language_from_config()
```

Get language setting from main config system.

### get_custom_replacements_from_config { #keecas.localization.get_custom_replacements_from_config }

```python
get_custom_replacements_from_config()
```

Get custom replacements from main config system.

### get_translations { #keecas.localization.get_translations }

```python
get_translations(language=None)
```

Get complete translation dictionary for a language.

Hierarchy: runtime_overrides -> config_replacements -> language_file

### translate { #keecas.localization.translate }

```python
translate(key, language=None, substitutions=None)
```

Translate a single key.

Priority: direct substitutions -> runtime -> config -> language file

### set_language { #keecas.localization.set_language }

```python
set_language(language)
```

Set the global language.

### get_language { #keecas.localization.get_language }

```python
get_language()
```

Get current global language.

### get_available_languages { #keecas.localization.get_available_languages }

```python
get_available_languages()
```

Get list of available language codes.

### set_runtime_override { #keecas.localization.set_runtime_override }

```python
set_runtime_override(key, value)
```

Set a runtime translation override.

### clear_runtime_overrides { #keecas.localization.clear_runtime_overrides }

```python
clear_runtime_overrides()
```

Clear all runtime overrides.

### reset_to_config { #keecas.localization.reset_to_config }

```python
reset_to_config()
```

Reset to config defaults, clearing runtime overrides.
